name: Uses Patch Baseline
description: An SSM managed instance's last patch operation used this patch baseline (managed instance -> baseline): DescribeInstancePatchStates' BaselineId, matched to the baseline's natural key. An AWS-provided baseline (its BaselineId is an ARN) is not collected while the baseline listing reads OWNER=Self only, so that edge finds no node and is skipped; the instance's patch_baseline_id keeps the id. A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_patch.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-patch-state).
